garantie.title: Guarantee & Returns
garantie.subtitle: 100% satisfaction guarantee — not good, money back.
garantie.gText: We stand behind our products. Not satisfied with your purchase? You'll get your money back within 7 days of receiving your package. No complicated procedures, no hassle.
garantie.conditionsText: The following conditions apply to the guarantee:
garantie.c1: You report your return within 7 days of receiving the package.
garantie.c3: The product is undamaged and in its original state.
garantie.c4: The product is returned in its original packaging.
garantie.how1: Contact us via the contact details below.
garantie.how2: Mention your order number and the reason for return.
garantie.how3: We will send you the return instructions.
garantie.how4: After receiving and checking the return package, you'll get your money back within 5 working days.
garantie.contactText: Questions or want to report a return? Contact us:
